newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Far East up on winning telecom bids.
newsitem.headline: Far East up on winning telecom bids.

text.p: Far Eastern Textile and several other Taiwan shares rose in early Tuesday trade after the communications ministry on late Monday awarded eight franchises to run the island's mobile phone business, brokers said.
After 45 minutes, Far Eastern surged T$1.2 or 4.0 percent to T$31.2 and Tuntex rose 70 cents or 3.71 percent to T$19.6 in active trade.
Pacific Wire opened higher at T$29.30 but lost 60 cents, or 2.11 percent to T$27.8.
Brokers said the new mobile phone business was expected to produce long-term profits.
"Initial studies show that these winners (of franchises) may fully pay back their investments in the 10th year once their projects start, and begin to enjoy profits after 10 years," Hung said.
